This is the main Lojban Wiki home of the '''The (Official Lojban) Dictionary Project''' (Lojban: '''catni vlaselcku selgu'a'''), an official project of the [[LFK]].

Eventually, the Project will have not just a page but a whole wiki of its own, located at http://vlaselcku.lojban.org or something like that.  After the new wiki comes online, this page will continue to exist, and contain a summary and a description and a link for the new dictionary wiki.

In the meantime, we will use this page as a chalkboard for discussing ideas and drawing up plans.  Please add information and resources directly on this page.  Add questions and suggestions to the [[Talk:LFK_Dictionary_Project|discussion page]].  Anyone can participate in the discussion, add ideas, or make suggestions.
